description: Puts online, in the client’s Shopify store, the preview they saw with store_preview and accepted: same product, same variant, same price. Without that preview, nothing goes out. The product becomes visible to their buyers.

produit.description: The `produit` reference returned by a search (starts with “p”).

variante.description: The preview’s variant number (optional: the preview’s one).
